text_block_list.text:
"One day, while I was still struggling to 
decide between the Tiara route and the 
Triple Crown route—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, dismissed! Bring your A-game 
tomorrow too, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Look! President Rudolf and 
Brian-senpai are running side by side!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, what a fierce dead heat! Good luck 
to both of youuu~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Huh? The President and Brian?

Hishi Amazon glanced over at the grounds. 
In the distance, she could see two figures 
running along the turf course.

Just past the 4th corner, approaching the 
goal. Symboli Rudolf is ahead, but the 
margin is razor-thin—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —ORAAAAGHH!

"Drawing level, Narita Brian roars as she 
surges past Symboli Rudolf."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Brian-senpai, that's amazing...! Wait, 
hold on, the President hasn't—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: She fought back and reclaimed the lead!!

Neither gave up the lead. Like wind, like 
light, the two plunged toward the finish 
line.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, you've gotten even better, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk. Don't get so full of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll tear you to shreds.

It was a masterclass of a race. Before 
anyone realized it, the once-frenzied 
crowd had fallen dead silent—

Hishi Amazon stared intently at the two of 
them, looking somewhat frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...I've still got plenty more training to 
do.

While still feeling concerned about Hishi 
Amazon—a few days passed.

It was decided that she would enter a 
2000m turf mock race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's get fired up, Trainy!

The mock race began with everyone fired 
up. However—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit, I'm completely boxed in, front 
and back!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, past the 3rd corner, and the center 
of attention, Hishi Amazon, is currently 
in 6th place!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Should I swing wide? With my legs, I 
could blast past them from there—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —ORAAAAGHH!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Brian-senpai, that's amazing...! Wait, 
hold on, the President hasn't—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: (—Damn it! Why am I getting so timid?!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Doesn't matter, I have to run faster, 
even faster! Otherwise... I'll never beat 
*her*!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
200 meters left! The leader hasn't 
changed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is closing in from the 
inside! However, from the outside, Number 
5 leaps into the lead!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is desperately clinging on! 
Will she catch up, or will the leader pull 
away?! Can she close the gap?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—Number 5 holds on wire-to-wire for the 
win!

The mock race drew to a close with Hishi 
Amazon's defeat, having run an 
uncharacteristically frantic race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Kh, dammit!! What the hell am I doing?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Even though we were in the middle of a 
race, I got scared, panicked, and delayed 
my move... What a pathetic run!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And here 'all-out match' is supposed to be 
'Hishi Amazon's' favorite phrase!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I haven't even managed to become "Hishi 
Amazon" yet...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to be worrying about 
whether she's "Narita Brian" or whoever 
the hell else!!

Watching the race, I could tell that 
something was off with Hishi Amazon.

"Once I calmed them down and listened 
carefully to what they had to say—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—I couldn't get the recent one-on-one 
showdown between Brian and the President 
out of my head.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The whole track was electric, quiet, and 
burning with intensity. Every single 
person watching was holding their breath.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And then, I realized it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, as I am right now, there's 
no way I could go head-to-head like that 
against Brian...!

Hishi Amazon's clenched fist was trembling 
slightly.

Desperately searching for words, wondering 
whether to comfort or encourage her—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —And so, I've decided!

Hishi Amazon looked straight ahead with 
enough conviction to blow away any worries 
I had.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I will become stronger!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If Brian's gonna blast through the Triple 
Crown, then I'm gonna blast through the 
Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If she's the strongest on the Triple Crown 
route, then I'll become the strongest on 
the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll become a "Hishi Amazon" worthy of 
challenging "Narita Brian"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And then, after that— on the grandest 
stage of all! At the Arima Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: A one-on-one duel with "Narita Brian"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
In this one year! I'll catch up to you! I 
won't lose! I haven't lost yet!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ain't that right, Trainy!

Swept along by Hishi Amazon's fiery 
passion, before I knew it, I was nodding 
in agreement.

And so, with a strengthened resolve for 
victory, our days of running relentlessly 
toward the Oka Sho had begun.
